Rashi on Meilah 20a:10:1.hebrew: אמרי כו' - הא ודאי ה"נ הוה מצי למיתני דודאי לא מעל, אבל מש"ה נקט בית של מערה משום דפסיקא ליה דלעולם לית בה מעילה, להכי (פסיקא הכי בא ליה למיתנייה):
Rashi on Meilah 20a:10:1.english: They say, etc. - Certainly, so too [the *tanna*] could have taught [the case of a house], for certainly [one who lives in it] has not misused. But for this reason he mentioned a house that is a cave: because it is conclusive for him that there is never misuse in it. Therefore (it was conclusive for him in this way to teach it):

Rashi on Meilah 20a:10:2.hebrew: בית של אבנים דעלמא לא פסיקא ליה - מילתא, דיש הפרש בין בנאו ולבסוף הקדישו, בין הקדישו ולבסוף בנאו. להכי לא תנייה. ולעולם דוקא הקדישו ולבסוף בנאו יש בו מעילה, דכתלוש דמי:
Rashi on Meilah 20a:10:2.english: A house of ordinary stones is not conclusive for him - [This is] a matter in which there is a difference between [a case where] he built it and afterward consecrated it, and [a case where] he consecrated [the materials] and afterward built it. Therefore, [the *tanna*] did not teach it. But in truth, specifically if he consecrated [the materials] and afterward built it, there is misuse in it, as it is considered like something detached.

Rashi on Meilah 20a:12:2.hebrew: לא עשה שליחותו - אלא שינה ממה שאמר לו בעה"ב, השליח מעל:
Rashi on Meilah 20a:12:2.english: He did not perform his agency - But rather he deviated from what the homeowner told him; the agent is liable for misuse.

Rashi on Meilah 20a:13:1.hebrew: תן בשר - של הקדש. מה שכתוב בגמרא: אמר לו: תן להם חתיכה חתיכה, והוא אומר: טלו ב' ב', והם נטלו ג' ג' — כולן מעלו. בעה"ב מעל, לפי שנעשה שליחותו בחתיכה א'; והשליח והאורחין מעלו, שכל א' וא' הוסיף א' מדעתו:
Rashi on Meilah 20a:13:1.english: Give meat - of the consecrated property. [As for what the Gemara says:] "He said to him: Give them a piece each," and he says: "Take two each," and they took three each — all of them committed misuse. The homeowner committed misuse, because his agency was carried out with [respect to] one piece; and the agent and the guests committed misuse, because each and every one added one [piece] on their own initiative.

Tosafot on Meilah 20a:12:1.hebrew: השליח שעשה שליחותו בעל הבית מעל - כדאמרינן לעיל באידך פירקין (מעילה דף יח:): דילפינן "חטא חטא" מתרומה:
Tosafot on Meilah 20a:12:1.english: An agent who performed his agency, the homeowner is liable for misuse - As we said earlier in the other chapter (Meilah 18b): we derive [this] from the [verbal analogy of] "sin, sin" from terumah.

Tosafot on Meilah 20a:13:1.hebrew: אמר לו תן בשר לאורחים ונתן להם כבד, כבד ונתן להם בשר — שליח מעל - שהרי לא עשה שליחותו של בעל הבית שצוה לו:
Tosafot on Meilah 20a:13:1.english: [If] he said to him, "Give meat to the guests," and he gave them liver; [or "give them] liver," and he gave them meat — the agent is liable for misuse - For he did not carry out the agency of the homeowner, who had commanded him.
